cohort: 221 pregnant women with gestational diabetes in their third trimester, recruited from outpatient clinics at Cairo University Hospitals
finding: Elevated serum uric acid levels (>5 mg/dl) were associated with an increased risk of neonatal complications (macrosomia, NICU admission), preterm delivery, premature rupture of membranes, oligohydramnios and cesarean section in women with gestational diabetes.
mod_finding: Elevated serum uric acid levels (>5 mg/dl) were associated with an increased risk of cesarean section in women with gestational diabetes.
